title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: potassium.jsx — classifyPotassium(), dynamicCaption(), and PotassiumDiagram(); unpictured inputs
findings.title: Impossible potassium values receive authoritative interpretations
findings.problem: Only finiteness is validated. Values such as k = 0 or k = -1 are classified as hypokalemia, matched to the hypokalemia strip, and given a caption discussing replacement. These are invalid serum potassium results, not interpretable examples of hypokalemia.
findings.fix: Reject nonpositive values at the shared interpretation boundary. Render an invalid-value/recheck message without a patient marker, matched ECG strip, or replacement-related worked interpretation. Test both the caption and diagram branches.

findings.where: Images 1, 4, 8, and 11 — Low K⁺ / IV replacement panel; potassium.jsx HYPO_IV and Frame desc
findings.title: Cardiac monitoring disappears from the primary safety panel
findings.problem: Fact 7 and the hypo-care caption/narration explicitly include cardiac monitoring during IV potassium administration. The inline panel lists only prohibited routes, dilution/pump use, and urine output; the SVG description also omits monitoring. A student viewing only the rationale figure misses a safety requirement the explainer says is part of this teaching.
findings.fix: Add cardiac monitoring to the IV replacement panel and its accessible description, using the same qualification across the facts, caption, narration, and figure.

findings.where: Images 7 and 14; step worked — hyperkalemia branch of dynamicCaption()
findings.title: Worked caption suggests potassium level alone ranks urgency
findings.problem: “The higher the level, the more urgent the response” is an unqualified comparison. A lower potassium with new conduction changes, symptoms, or a rapid rise can demand a more immediate response than a higher stable result. The scenario-dependent qualification in hyper-care is lost in the worked conclusion—the part students are likely to reuse for priority questions.
findings.fix: Replace the comparison with: “Urgency depends on the potassium level, symptoms and ECG findings, rate of change, renal function, and clinical context; a normal ECG does not exclude danger.” Do not generate a universal urgency ranking from k alone.

assessment: Hold publication. Invalid inputs receive clinical interpretations, the inline replacement panel omits a stated safety requirement, and the worked caption overgeneralizes urgency.
